periods.location: Hagun Academy; Kaito's hospital room (via phone report)
periods.summary: Ayase self-reports her cheating and is suspended, while Kaito awakens from his two-year coma after the dojo is reclaimed.
periods.cause: Ayase wants to take responsibility for the illegal tactics she used against Ikki.
periods.process: After returning to school she confesses to the selection committee. Oreki's mediation and Ayase's voluntary confession prevent expulsion but cannot save her tournament eligibility. Later she messages Ikki that Kaito has awakened; a phone call shows Kaito energetically joking about marrying Ayase to Ikki and having him inherit the dojo.
periods.outcome: Ayase receives ten days suspension and disqualification; Kaito's recovery gives hope for father-daughter closure.
periods.aftermath: Ikki and Stella conclude the Ayase incident has reached a peaceful stopping point, even if Ayase may spend more time with her father than training.
periods.significance: Completes Ayase's responsibility arc and converts Kaito from a trapped symbol of regret into a living, comic presence.
